notablePrerequisites: Accomplished Alchemist does not have summoning sickness. You have gained at least 5 life this turn.
description:
Activate Accomplished Alchemist's second ability by tapping it, adding at least five mana of any color.
Activate Staff of Domination's third ability by paying {3} and tapping it, untapping Accomplished Alchemist.
Activate Staff of Domination's first ability by paying {1}, untapping it.
Repeat.
